# Credits and licenses

Brag's upstream MIT license is included as [LICENSE](./LICENSE), so its
attribution and permissions travel with a self-contained project copy.

This toolkit generalizes locally authored FamFlix video tooling. Its English
phoneme normalization follows the Kokoro JavaScript implementation by
hexgrad/Xenova (Apache-2.0); see
[Kokoro](https://github.com/hexgrad/kokoro) and the installed package's LICENSE.
The Bella voice vectors ship with the pinned `kokoro-js` package.

- Kokoro-82M model: Apache-2.0, pinned source revision recorded in the scripts.
- Whisper tiny.en: MIT, pinned source revision recorded in the scripts.
- Hyperframes: Apache-2.0; local composition/rendering engine.
- Transformers.js: Apache-2.0; local inference and recognition.
- GSAP: [standard license](https://gsap.com/community/standard-license/).
- Geist and Fraunces: SIL Open Font License, included through pinned Fontsource
  packages; each profile declares the font/asset license it uses.
- Playwright: Apache-2.0; local composition-state/browser validation.
- Node.js: MIT and its included notices; pinned isolated tooling runtime.
- The generated instrumental score and fixture illustrations are original.

No bundled Brag stock-music track is required by this workflow. If a project
chooses external music, artwork, fonts or logos, record and honor its separate
license. Do not infer asset permission from the repository's MIT license.

Reference fixtures contain fictional demonstration data. They are private
reference material and do not include application source, real accounts or
credentials. Do not publish them without separate approval.
